'''Dawn''' can refer to the followng:

==Animals==
*[[Dawn Wind]] - a horse owned by [[Elenia Sarand]].
*[[Snowy Dawn]] - an irascible wolf known to [[Perrin Aybara]].
*[[Winter Dawn]] - another wolf known to Perrin.

==Chapter titles==
*''[[New Spring/Chapter 11|Just Before Dawn]]'' - the eleventh chapter of ''[[New Spring]]''.
*''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 34|He Who Comes With the Dawn]]'' - the thirty-forth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
*''[[A Crown of Swords/Chapter 3|Hill of the Golden Dawn]]'' - the third chapter of ''[[A Crown of Swords]]''.

==Other==
*[[Al'cair'rahienallen]] - meaning "Hill of the Golden Dawn" in the [[Old Tongue]], a city that later became [[Cairhien (city)|Cairhien]].
*[[Blue Sky Dawning]] - a song title used as a code word by the [[Blue Ajah]].
*The [[Cliffs of Dawn]] - an extensive range of cliffs on the northeaster edge of the [[Aiel Waste]].
*[[He Who Comes With the Dawn]] - a different name for the ''Car'a'carn'' amoung the Aiel.
*''rahien'' - "dawn" in the Old Tongue.
*[[Rahien Demain]] - a [[Kandor]]i lord born at the end of the [[Aiel War]].
*The ''[[Rahien Sorei]]'' - an [[Aiel]] [[Aiel warrior societies|warrior society]], meening "Dawn Runners" in the [[Old Tongue]].
